Title: On-premises users see inconsistent results when viewing the hybrid free/busy information for Exchange Online users

User impact: On-premises users see inconsistent results when viewing the hybrid free/busy information for Exchange Online users.

More info: While we investigate this issue, we recommend adjusting the hybrid default setting from "LimitedDetails" to "AvailabilityOnly" to avoid the impact.

Current status: We're reviewing the event trace logs provided by a subset of affected users, as well as recent service changes, to determine the source of this issue so we can develop steps towards impact remediation.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and on-premises users attempting to view hybrid free/busy information for Exchange Online users are impacted. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 8:30 PM UTC
